periods.time: Philphy engagement party and graduation trip
periods.description: Large commercial group led by Riley Aingram. It hosts Philphy's engagement party and operates hotels in the capital and Rairel Town.
periods.history: Longstanding wealthy merchant power tied to Philphy and Riley.
periods.goals: Support Lux and Philphy, coordinate merchants and logistics for the New Kingdom, preserve commercial influence.
periods.structure: Merchant conglomerate led by Riley with hotels and shops under its control.
